questions.question: What is the error code for Dān Pāi Jiǎo (Front Slap Kick)?
What are the deduction points for Dān Pāi Jiǎo (Front Slap Kick)?
questions.answer: Deductions are applied when: 1) Toes of slapped foot not above shoulder height, 2) Slap missed and/or inaudible.
choices: The heel of the supporting leg should remain on the floor throughout the kick.

Both the supporting leg and the raised leg should be completely straight, with no bending at the knees.
